info.name: Sommelier Finance Integrations Vault Data API

params.name: network
params.description: The network the vault is on. Currently supports: ethereum.

params.name: vaultAddress
params.description: The address of the vault you want data for.

params.name: startUnixTimestamp
params.description: The unix timestamp of the start of the data you want.

params.name: endUnixTimestamp
params.description: The unix timestamp of the end of the data you want. Replace with the word `latest` to get all data up to the present time.

items.docs: Returns daily snapshots of a vault, captured at midnight UTC. Includes the daily APY (already decimal-adjusted), share price, base-asset price, total assets and USD-denominated TVL for each day in the requested range.

info.name: Get daily data for all cellars

params.name: network
params.description: The network the vault is on. Currently supports: ethereum.

params.name: startUnixTimestamp
params.description: The unix timestamp of the start of the data you want.

params.name: endUnixTimestamp
params.description: The unix timestamp of the end of the data you want. Replace with the word `latest` to get all data up to the present time.

items.docs: Returns daily snapshots for every cellar on the network, keyed by cellar address. Each value is an array of daily snapshots (without the cellar_address field, which becomes the map key).

params.name: network
params.description: The network the vault is on. Currently supports: ethereum.

params.name: vaultAddress
params.description: The address of the vault you want data for.

params.name: startUnixTimestamp
params.description: The unix timestamp of the start of the data you want.

params.name: endUnixTimestamp
params.description: The unix timestamp of the end of the data you want. Replace with the word `latest` to get all data up to the present time.

items.docs: Returns hourly snapshots of a vault. Parameters are identical to the daily data endpoint; the response does not include an APY value.

params.name: network
params.description: The network the vault is on. Currently supports: ethereum.

items.docs: Returns a point-in-time snapshot for a specific cellar, including USD TVL, base-asset TVL, the SOMM price, SOMM emissions per day and the SOMM incentive APY.
